about: The layers of src/ and what each may use (#344). docs/ARCHITECTURE.md shows this table; tools/check_layers.py checks the include edges, the symbol references of the built objects and the headers against it.

layers.name: public
layers.what: the public C ABI; its functions are defined in engine and base

layers.name: base
layers.what: freestanding utilities: heap, errors, hardware probe, threads

layers.name: quant
layers.what: the quantization contract: block layouts and codec declarations, defined in formats

layers.name: io
layers.what: GGUF and safetensors readers, file mapping

layers.name: formats
layers.what: per-quant decode of GGUF tensors, the AWQ scale loader

layers.name: sampling
layers.what: token sampling on host logits: greedy, top-k/top-p, repetition and DRY penalties

layers.name: backend_common
layers.what: the shared compute library: GEMM facade, gemma4 kernels, KIVI, host buffers

layers.name: cpu_x86
layers.what: backend: x86-64-v3 with AVX-512/VNNI dispatch; falls back to cpu_scalar, the portable reference, for the fused table, the resolver and the kernels it has none of its own for (#441)

layers.name: transformer
layers.what: arch: the decoder stack, families, forward blocks, weight loading

layers.name: engine
layers.what: orchestration: model load, sessions, tokenizers, registries

fragments.src/backends/cpu_neon/attention_kv.h: a template: the including file defines NKV_INT4 first, so the loop body specializes per cache
fragments.src/backends/cpu_x86/attention_driver.h: a template: each including file defines ax_run_item, called by name rather than through a pointer
